candidate.user_input: Do I need to resubmit a Growth and Development (G&D) request that I already submitted as a GitLab issue now that the process is transitioning to Compass?
candidate.reference: If you already have a GitLab issue open and it is in progress or already moving through approval, you do not need to resubmit it.

evidence.quote:
- If you already have a GitLab issue open and it is in progress or already moving through approval, you do not need to resubmit it.

If you already have a G&D GitLab issue open and it is already in progress or moving through approval, there is no need to resubmit it. Existing GitLab issue-based requests can continue through completion under the prior process.
evidence.contribution: This states that ongoing GitLab issue G&D requests do not require resubmission during the Compass transition.

candidate.connection: The context explicitly states that ongoing GitLab issue G&D requests do not need to be resubmitted during the Compass transition.

source_conditions: All new G&D requests must be submitted through Compass.
If you already have a GitLab issue open and it is in progress or already moving through approval, you do not need to resubmit it.
Existing GitLab issue-based requests can continue through completion under the prior process.
